tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search OptiLibra's catalog of optical networking equipment for AI and data center networks: 400G/800G DCI/DWDM transport (DCI5800, DCI5800-T8E2 800G transponder), optical switches and OXC matrices up to 64×64, EDFA amplifiers, OLP protection, OTDR/OCM monitoring, WSS and passive DWDM components. tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get the documented specifications, images and source of one product by slug or model (from search_products). Figures not documented are not invented; reach, OSNR, prices and lead times are confirmed per quote.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Submit a request for quotation (RFQ) to OptiLibra on behalf of a buyer. Only call this when the buyer has asked for a quote and provided their real name, work email, company and country. Returns a tracking ID; an engineer replies to the work email within 24 hours.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
